Matthew Yglesias (@mattyglesias)

I don't really think this is true. The vast majority of Democrats are going to back Platner in Maine and Peltola in Alaska.

— https://nitter.net/asymmetricinfo/status/2

The other is that they are not very honest, and just won't own up to this.
